entities.name: Delphine
entities.description: Priestess and inquisitor of the Church of Tal who hunted spellcasters, killed by Mairsil.

entities.name: Voska
entities.description: Mage arrested and questioned by Delphine, shot with crossbow bolts and killed.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Mage who blinded Delphine with a flash of light and escaped.

entities.name: Sima
entities.description: Captured by Delphine through a false rumor, later freed by Jodah.

entities.name: Ith's Rag Man
entities.description: Helped Jodah out of the city.

entities.name: Battle of Pitdown
entities.description: Battle after which Jodah freed Sima.

entities.name: Betje
entities.description: Miracle Worker enlisted by Delphine to track Jodah and Sima.

entities.name: Conclave of Mages
entities.description: Group of mages assaulted by Delphine.

entities.name: Mairsil the Pretender
entities.description: Wielded the Wand of Ith and killed Delphine.

entities.name: Wand of Ith
entities.description: Wand used by Mairsil to drain Delphine's defenses.

entities.name: Lord Ith
entities.description: Freed from Barl's Cage by Jodah and Sima.

entities.name: Barl's Cage
entities.description: Cage from which Lord Ith was freed.

entities.name: Fall of the Conclave of Mages
entities.description: Collapse of the Conclave that Delphine's assault inadvertently caused.

events.summary: Delphine questions Voska and Jodah in Alsoor; Jodah blinds her and escapes, and Voska is killed.
events.quote: Casting a flash of light spell, Jodah blinded Delphine and her guards

events.summary: Delphine plants a false rumor of Voska's survival and captures Sima.
events.quote: Delphine later planted a false rumor of Voska's survival

events.summary: Jodah and Sima set a fire freeing prisoners; Delphine corners them but Jodah reflects her flames and they escape on her horse.
events.quote: his mirror reflected the fire onto Delphine

events.summary: Delphine enlists Betje to track Sima and Jodah.
events.quote: Delphine enlisted the aid of the Miracle Worker Betje

events.summary: Delphine leads an assault on the Conclave of Mages and is killed by Mairsil with the Wand of Ith.
events.quote: Mairsil drained all of Delphine's magical defenses, and then stabbed her in the chest, killing her

relations.quote: She formed part of the Order of St. Zil

relations.note: Stabbed her with the Wand of Ith.
relations.quote: then stabbed her in the chest, killing her
To track down Jodah and Sima, Delphine enlisted the aid of the Miracle Worker Betje
Delphine and Betje followed her there
